title: Digital Inclusion: Skilling for Employability
summary: Promote digital literacy and employability for marginalized youth and adults through community-based training centers.
description:
Saksham Trust has established dedicated digital skilling centers at accessible locations such as Chhutmalpur and Ambheta to build essential 21st-century skills. Through structured training modules, individuals are equipped with digital competencies, job-ready skills, and entrepreneurship guidance.

By combining practical training with mentorship, the program enables participants to access formal employment or pursue independent livelihoods. This initiative directly complements government objectives for digital inclusion and the Skill India mission, bridging socio-economic gaps in employability.
